name: The Vault Key: Ruining Daddy’s Empire
original_name: The Vault Key: Ruining Daddy’s Empire
overview:
A four-year-old girl sets out to find the billionaire father she’s never met.

With a hidden key and a brave heart, she steps into a world of secrets and power.

She uncovers the truth behind her parents’ broken past and exposes those who tore them apart.

And when the missing pieces finally come together, one family’s fate begins to change.
